note: Which data sheet reflectance rows (packs/base-reference mixtures, optical.reflectance) each kernel ground material reads in True, fresh and fully weathered. A drawing choice, not physics: it moves into packs/base-surface (each material naming its rows) in the golden lane; fudge register 'True ground rows named in the renderer'. A material with no row keeps the palette. Rows are read only where space reaches the ground (a tile with `maturity`), so 'sediment' there is impact-gardened fines, the same soil as 'regolith'.
